punchline: Singer's inner roommate never stops judging, and the one who can ask "which part of me is bothered?" is not the roommate.
thirty_sec: Michael Singer asks you to treat the voice in your head as a roommate who judges, criticizes and nitpicks all day. His test is one question: which part of me is bothered by this? Then he asks who sees when you see, and who knows that you know. It is a spiritual teaching, not a lab result, so the point is to try it on a bad Tuesday and see.
